subject.title: fix(session): defer flushPendingToolResults by one event-loop tick

question: Should maintainers require redacted Feishu or comparable production-runner proof before accepting this one-tick defer as the fix for the missing tool-result race?
rationale: The source boundary and focused tests line up with the reported race, but the user-visible failure is a production-path session/channel behavior and the external PR proof is still synthetic/helper-level.

options.title: Require production-path proof
options.body: Ask for redacted Feishu, channel, or runner logs/screenshots showing real tool results persist without synthetic missing-result entries before merge.

options.title: Accept source-only timing risk
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally merge based on the shared-helper diff and focused tests while owning the remaining production-path uncertainty.

options.title: Pause behind the canonical issue
options.body: Keep the PR paused behind https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/84134 until someone can produce transport or production-runner proof.

recommendation.title: Require production-path proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted Feishu, channel, or runner logs/screenshots showing real tool results persist without synthetic missing-result entries before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The proof-sufficiency decision centers on the session guard and synthetic tool-result behavior that his history introduced in this area.
